survivors.skill_set: Agentic workflow design, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop system design, workflow automation product management (as named in the Google Director and Anthropic Workflows postings)
survivors.deepbench_has: A work-order screen, a delegation broker (16 routings a month), durable multi-hop loops with checkpoints, a quality-gate reviewer and the Audit Pipeline Log; the pieces exist but no visitor can hand the platform one business job and get it back finished.
survivors.new_work: A 'process' object (steps, owners, gates) attached to a work order; a lead-agent plan step; sequential delegation across bench agents with the visitor approval gate; a delivered-artifact record; a work-order timeline view.
survivors.pull_test: VC-ROOT-001 and VC-MISSION-034 are served directly: every target posting asks for someone who has shipped agentic workflows, and an evaluator who watches one job go from request to approved artifact has seen it. Pattern 149 does not bite because a governed multi-agent process a stranger can drive is not a standard skill, and pattern 137 does not bite because it is the product, not process paperwork.
survivors.scope_rationale: Broker, loops and gate primitives exist; the new work is the process object, the plan hop and the timeline view. Cheapest variant: one fixed three-step process template before a general editor.
survivors.description: Build the Process Autopilot on the work-order screen: a work order carries a process definition (ordered steps, the agent role for each, which steps are approval gates); a lead agent plans the run, the durable loop delegates each step through the broker, the visitor approves at gates, and the finished artifact is attached to the work order with a timeline of every hop. trends_index.trend: Agentic AI / multi-agent systems / digital workforce
trends_index.one_line: Gartner puts task-specific agents in 40% of enterprise apps by end of 2026 (from 5%), Forrester defines a digital employee as one that runs an end-to-end process, and Salesforce bills 2.4 billion 'agentic work units'; you must be able to say which steps an agent owns, where the human gate sits, and what it cost.
Every production example (ATARC procurement, AP exceptions, browser agents) keeps the decision with a person; you must show gates by blast radius, not blanket approval.
67% of IDP initiatives are evaluating agentic approaches; buyers require confidence scores and human review, and contracts, solicitations, invoices and records are the four workloads.

trends_index.trend: Retrieval-augmented generation with citations and permissions
trends_index.one_line: Claude for Financial Services promises every claim links to its source and enterprise search lives or dies on permission-aware retrieval; you must explain chunking, citation enforcement and access filtering in one breath.

trends_index.trend: Conversational analytics over a semantic layer
trends_index.one_line: Text-to-SQL alone gives different numbers to the same question; the 2026 answer is certified metrics, permission checks before the query runs, and the definition shown with the chart.

trends_index.trend: Deep research and always-on briefing agents
trends_index.one_line: OpenAI deep research (5-30 minute cited reports), Microsoft Autopilots and ChatGPT Work cloud agents define the product: a finished, cited artifact delivered without being asked.

trends_index.trend: Agentic customer and employee service with resolution-rate economics
trends_index.one_line: Gartner's 80%-by-2029, a 41% median deflection today, and per-resolution pricing mean you must talk about resolution rate, re-contact and cost per outcome, not chatbot features.
Anthropic's index shows sales outreach automation doubling on the API and 41% of enterprise B2B teams run an AI SDR; the working model is hybrid (AI researches and drafts, humans send).

GovDash's $5B of customer wins, the ATARC FAR-citation pilot and state AI procurement rules make solicitation shredding, compliance matrices and cited bid scoring the government features to have built.

trends_index.trend: AI ROI accountability and outcome-based pricing
trends_index.one_line: Deloitte finds 20% achieving hoped-for revenue, McKinsey ties value to leading KPIs, and vendors bill per resolution or work unit; you must show cost per outcome per use case.

trends_index.trend: Use-case selection as the top AI product skill
trends_index.one_line: Across 12,400 postings it is the most-screened capability; the Anthropic Workflows and OpenAI Enterprise PM roles are literally 'identify and validate high-impact use cases'.

trends_index.trend: Custom and shared agents for every worker (agent builders)
trends_index.one_line: Anthropic's 'everybody having their own custom agent' with private plugin marketplaces, ChatGPT Work's shared agents, and OpenAI retiring its visual builder for natural-language agents set the shape: describe, test, share.
a16z sizes browser agents at $12B in 2026 and Microsoft put Computer Use into Cowork; the story you tell is gated actions plus audit logging on portals without APIs.

Forrester's AP use cases, Anthropic's invoice and email-classification workflows, and OpenAI's finance-first enterprise PM make invoices, email triage and scheduling the canonical back-office agents.
Half of ERP vendors will ship autonomous governance modules and 1,561 state AI bills landed by March 2026; paragraph-level citation from rule to policy is the feature.
